messages:
deploybot: [AUTO] Deploy slot 324 -> PAUSED for app=redwood-edge (eu-west-1). Reason: 3xx/5xx surge detected on canary hosts. Pause initiated at 2024-09-15T14:12:08Z.
alex: saw it. 502 rates jumped to ~18% on canary.
priya: pinging infra — can we confirm if it's an upstream throttle or our load balancer?
jamie: checking LB metrics, looks like connection errors between edge and model-serving pool. tails:
```
500 GET /v1/generate 2024-09-15T14:11:57Z host=ip-10-0-4-7 error=upstream_reset
```
samir: model-serving CPU on canaries spiked to 95% during the roll, maybe kernel-level coffee.
leah: so do we rollback canary or pause global rollout? we have users in EU on a major release.
priya: hold global, keep canary paused. we should reclaim the slot for hotfix-only if needed. Priya/ops decision.
alex: can we pin the release to previous model version 3.1.2 for eu-west-1 while we investigate? That avoids global churn.
priya: yes — plan: 1) abort current canary batch, 2) pin eu-west to model v3.1.2, 3) reschedule remaining batches to tomorrow 0700 UTC. Anyone object?
jamie: +1, will prepare the rollback script. I'll run `deploy rollback --slot=324 --target-model=3.1.2` and attach runbook.
ops-bot: @oncall paging samir — incident created INC-2024-304: Edge canary 502 surge. Pinged oncall.
samir: on it, grabbing logs and kernel dmesg. leaning toward an autoscaling quirk combined with a bad kernel update on 2 hosts.
priya: good. alex, please draft the release note update: mark EU rollout deferred and add mitigation steps.
alex: on it, will add a short blurb and push to /releases/notes. Also notifying partner teams.
jamie: running rollback in 5m, will post status.
jamie: rollback complete on slot 324. canary health back to baseline (2% errors). verified traffic shifted to v3.1.2.
priya: thanks. reschedule: new window 2024-09-16 07:00 UTC, staggered across zones, notify eng-releases and product.
leah: added calendar invite and updated release board.
alex: release note updated and pinned. tagging @support in case of user reports.
priya: closing action items: samir to follow up with infra on kernel/autoscale, jamie to add rollback flag to the canary playbook, alex to update notes. We'll reopen if anything else pops.
samir: filing infra ticket INF-2024-847, will attach host-level findings.
alex: thanks team :thumbsup:
deploybot: [AUTO] Thread closed: deploy slot 324 marked ROLLED_BACK by jamie at 2024-09-15T15:01:40Z.
